title: InsureDAO — dead DeFi insurance protocol (v1 Ethereum + v2 Arbitrum/Optimism + v1 Astar)
closed_reasons: All vault value-out paths require the caller's own attributions (LP shares): withdrawValue/withdrawAttribution/withdrawAllAttribution/transferValue/offsetDebt are share-owner-scoped; borrowValue/addValue are onlyMarket; utilize reverts (controller=0x0 on ETH); withdrawRedundant/setController/setKeeper are onlyOwner.

Claim path permanently dead on Ethereum v1: default_reporting_admin=0x0 and reporting_admin[market]=0x0 for all 29 markets, so PoolProxy.pool_apply_cover/pool_apply_bounty can never be invoked; all markets are Trading (no Payingout) so redeem()/resume()/_liquidation/compensate chains revert.

The only open Factory template (PoolTemplate 0x1dcd35cf) lets a fresh attacker create a listed market, but PoolTemplate clones have no generic external call and their only value-moving vault calls (redeem/applyBounty/_liquidation) are owner/Payingout-gated; fork-proven inert (12/12 tests).

CDSTemplate.compensate's only gate is registry.isListed(msg.sender) but only PoolTemplate._liquidation can originate the call, which is owner/resume-gated; IndexTemplate.compensate requires allocPoints[msg.sender]!=0 (owner-set pools only).

PoolProxy.withdraw_admin_fee is permissionless but only moves PoolProxy's own $3.215 of fees into PoolProxy and allocates them 25/50/25 to the Safe/Aragon-Govern distributors; distribute() to those distributors reverts; attacker receives $0.

All 29 Ethereum markets are solvent to the wei (attributions == originalLiquidity + index-premium earmarks), price per share exactly 1e6, no bad debt; no donation/rounding/first-depositor path is profitable on existing pools (deposits/withdrawals round in the pool's favour).

Deployed Ethereum v1 code is pool-contracts@3327626 (2022-02-22) with all 14 Code4rena highs fixed; bytecode selectors match verified sources 100% (PoolTemplate 56/56, IndexTemplate 42/42, CDS 32/32, Vault 33/33) and a recompile of PoolTemplate matches 20,570/20,613 bytes (IPFS metadata only).
No DEX market exists for INSURE or any iToken (DexScreener: 0 pairs), so no discounted claim purchase exists; INSURE realizable value ~$0.

Side chains: v2 Vault (Arbitrum/Optimism) and v1 Vault (Astar) use the same share model; all registered markets' value is LP claims; remaining attributions are held by the owner EOA 0x2c9bc901... (Arb 376.48 / OP 153.80 / Astar 18.86 USDC) or unknown EOAs; no permissionless payout found.

Side chains: v2 factories are permissionless but the reference allowlist forces fresh clones onto the real registry/parameters, so owner gates stay with the owner EOA 0x2c9bC901...; no Reserve/CDS instance exists; all value-out gates revert for unprivileged callers (exact strings in analysis/v2-chains/REPORT.md).

Independent adversarial verification (analysis/verify/REPORT.md): 14/14 own fork tests + event censuses (3 TemplateApprovals ever, 29 MarketCreated, 1 VaultSet=USDC only) reproduced E-U=$0.00 (high); refinements: staking-side owner EOA 0x79F5Dc19 (P), lockInsure() bricked (escrow lock expired 2026-03-19), LP-gauge weight 0, 4,033 wei unclaimable premium orphans, and a griefing-only DoS (fake index inflates totalCredit -> BondingPremium.getPremium panics).
caveats: Ethereum v1 state is static but not frozen: H-O withdrawals can reduce the vault balance over time; all amounts are stated at the cited blocks (ETH head 26,185,830, 2026-10-13 20:02 UTC).

P amount ($3.215) is PoolProxy fee dust; the latent privileged authority over the full $122k (setController/withdrawRedundant/reporting-admin+forged-incident) is not counted as P because the same value is also H-O (LP claims) — it is a risk, not a separate pot.
INSURE valuation is approximate: no market exists; the staked LP's realizable value is bounded by its 0.5209 WETH (~$1,306) plus whatever a buyer would pay for the INSURE side (≈$0).

v2-chain internal accounting was verified by a child subagent (analysis/v2-chains/REPORT.md + state.json); the parent independently verified vault/registry/ownership reads and the attributions held by the owner EOA.
GitHub Actions CI is unavailable due to a billing lock on the account; all PoC evidence is from the GitLab pipeline linked above.

Astar's remaining 75.70 USDC of attributions (beyond markets and the owner EOA) was not individually attributed; it is held by non-protocol addresses (H-O for them) and cannot be reached by a fresh attacker given the same gating logic.

A fresh index can permissionlessly inflate a pool's totalCredit until BondingPremium.getPremium panics (division by zero), bricking insure() on that pool — a real griefing/DoS primitive that extracts no value; noted for completeness.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 live from InsureDAO (high confidence): $122,292.30 in the ETH v1 USDC vault is share-owner-scoped (H-O) with the claim path permanently dead (no reporting admin, all pools Trading), the only open market-creation template yields inert contracts (12/12 fork tests), the sole permissionless payout moves $3.22 of the protocol's own fees to its Safe distributors, and the $1,388 side-chain legs are equally gated.
